result.brief: 提出 NativeDrive：复用原生统一理解-生成骨干，将理解专家的 token 预测接口用于离散策略、生成专家用于连续策略，并用生成式语义编辑提供稠密场景结构监督，实现无编码器的自动驾驶统一框架。
result.reason: Adapts a native unified understanding-generation backbone for driving policy, reusing generation expert for dense semantic supervision; contributes to unified multimodal modeling though application-focused.
